derivation:
apply WithLp.toLp_injective 2
  simpa [subProj, Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp] using (Submodule.starProjection_apply_eq_zero_iff K).mpr h
explanation: Mathlib says the orthogonal projection of a vector is zero exactly when the vector is orthogonal to the submodule. Unfolding `subProj` and translating matrix-vector multiplication through `Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp` gives the stated raw-matrix result; the existing proof also applies this Mathlib theorem directly.
